req.title: Set cookie via path
req.statement: The system shall set a cookie of name=<name>, value=<value> and redirect to /cookies when GET /cookies/set/<name>/<value> is called.

doc.reasoning: The requirement states that GET /cookies/set/<name>/<value> must issue a Set-Cookie header with the given name/value and return a 302 redirect to /cookies. Tests cover: (1) positive EP – normal alphanumeric name/value sets cookie and redirects; (2) negative NEG – verifying the redirect target is exactly /cookies, not any other path; (3) boundary BVA – single-character name and value (minimal length); (4) STC – state transition: cookie is actually readable at /cookies after following the redirect; (5) DT – special characters in value; (6) BVA – empty string value (boundary at zero-length value). Each test uses exact-value assertions to maximise mutation kill rate.

tests.name: test_set_cookie_via_path_positive_returns_302_and_set_cookie_header
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_set_cookie_via_path_positive_returns_302_and_set_cookie_header():
    r = client.get('/cookies/set/testname/testvalue', follow_redirects=False)
    assert r.status_code == 302
    set_cookie = r.headers.get('Set-Cookie', '')
    assert 'testname=testvalue' in set_cookie
    location = r.headers.get('Location', '')
    assert location == '/cookies'

test_set_cookie_via_path_positive_returns_302_and_set_cookie_header()

tests.name: test_set_cookie_via_path_redirect_target_is_exactly_cookies
expected: Location header equals exactly /cookies, not /cookies/set or any other path
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_set_cookie_via_path_redirect_target_is_exactly_cookies():
    r = client.get('/cookies/set/mykey/myval', follow_redirects=False)
    assert r.status_code == 302
    location = r.headers.get('Location', '')
    assert location == '/cookies'
    assert location != '/cookies/set'
    assert location != '/cookies/set/mykey/myval'
    assert location != ''

test_set_cookie_via_path_redirect_target_is_exactly_cookies()

tests.name: test_set_cookie_via_path_cookie_readable_after_redirect
actions: Assert final response is 200 and contains cookie data
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
import json
client = app.test_client()

def test_set_cookie_via_path_cookie_readable_after_redirect():
    r = client.get('/cookies/set/session_id/abc123', follow_redirects=True)
    assert r.status_code == 200
    data = json.loads(r.data)
    assert 'cookies' in data
    assert data['cookies']['session_id'] == 'abc123'

test_set_cookie_via_path_cookie_readable_after_redirect()

tests.name: test_set_cookie_via_path_name_and_value_exact_match_in_set_cookie
actions: Inspect Set-Cookie header for exact name=value pair
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_set_cookie_via_path_name_and_value_exact_match_in_set_cookie():
    r = client.get('/cookies/set/color/blue', follow_redirects=False)
    assert r.status_code == 302
    set_cookie = r.headers.get('Set-Cookie', '')
    assert 'color=blue' in set_cookie
    assert 'color=red' not in set_cookie
    assert 'colour=blue' not in set_cookie

tests.name: test_set_cookie_via_path_empty_value_boundary
expected: If 302: Set-Cookie header present with emptykey=
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_set_cookie_via_path_empty_value_boundary():
    r = client.get('/cookies/set/emptykey/', follow_redirects=False)
    # Flask routing may or may not match trailing slash; record actual behaviour
    assert r.status_code in (302, 404, 308)
    if r.status_code == 302:
        set_cookie = r.headers.get('Set-Cookie', '')
        assert 'emptykey' in set_cookie
        location = r.headers.get('Location', '')
        assert location == '/cookies'

test_set_cookie_via_path_empty_value_boundary()

tests.name: test_set_cookie_via_path_multiple_different_cookies_independent
expected: First sets alpha=1, second sets beta=2
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
import json
client = app.test_client()

def test_set_cookie_via_path_multiple_different_cookies_independent():
    r1 = client.get('/cookies/set/alpha/1', follow_redirects=False)
    assert r1.status_code == 302
    sc1 = r1.headers.get('Set-Cookie', '')
    assert 'alpha=1' in sc1
    assert r1.headers.get('Location') == '/cookies'
    r2 = client.get('/cookies/set/beta/2', follow_redirects=False)
    assert r2.status_code == 302
    sc2 = r2.headers.get('Set-Cookie', '')
    assert 'beta=2' in sc2
    assert r2.headers.get('Location') == '/cookies'

test_set_cookie_via_path_multiple_different_cookies_independent()
